text:
kristen: quick heads up — i'll open a PR that renames module `db/connector` -> `db/postgres-connector`. it's mostly a folder rename + moving provider config into the module root.
oliver: sounds good. will this change provider pins or lockfile?
kristen: yes — i'll update the `required_providers` map and regenerate `.terraform.lock.hcl`. CI will fail the plan if the lockfile differs. i can include lockfile changes in the same PR or split into a follow-up if folks prefer.
maya: please keep the old outputs that other services reference — add a compatibility shim output (marked deprecated) so consumers aren't broken immediately.
kristen: yep planning to add `output "db_connection_string_old"` with a deprecation note. will keep it for ~2 weeks and document the migration.
kevin: can you paste the provider pin snippet you'll use?
kristen: sure — here's the `required_providers` block i'm planning:
```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    postgresql = {
      source  = "registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/postgresql"
      version = "~> 1.8"
    }
  }
}
```
oliver: also consider an explicit `provider "postgresql" {}` in the module with an alias? some envs rely on root provider, others expect module-scoped.
kristen: i'll keep root provider mapping for back-compat and add an explicit module provider with `alias = "module"` so we can migrate consumers gradually.
infra-bot: CI notice — plan job for PR #4521 queued
kevin: reminder — run `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=linux_arm64` after the pin change. we need both platforms locked for our pooled images.
kristen: will do. my local command: 
```bash
TF_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR=~/.terraform.d/plugin-cache terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=linux_arm64
```
oliver: small warning from yesterday — upgrading provider 1.7 -> 1.8 caused a `schema_force_new` diff for one resource in staging. recommend a quick staging apply before prod.
maya: also check secrets wiring carefully — the module used to expose `db_password` as an output. we want to remove that and write it to SSM parameter instead. please add a migration note for consumers on how to read the SSM param.
kristen: good call. i'll add MIGRATION.md to the PR and keep the deprecated output for 2 weeks while we notify teams.
kevin: i can run the staging apply and smoke test tomorrow morning if you want.
kristen: appreciated — please do.
infra-bot: CI update — plan job for PR #4521 completed (1 warning)
oliver: ping when PR is up, i'll focus my review on provider blocks and lockfile diffs.
kristen: thanks — aiming to open in the next 30m and will tag @oliver @kevin for review.
kevin: :thumbsup:
maya: :raised_hands:
